name: Takatsukasa Mikoto
original_name: タカツカサ ミコト
source:
General clerical staff working at the Far East Branch.

A girl who embodies Yurufuwa and is the last member of the once prestigious Takatsukasa family. She seems to be obsessed with a certain employee who is currently away from the branch, but...
